articles.title: Trump backs CFTC authority over prediction markets
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump says it is “critically important” that the CFTC has sole authority over prediction markets, and took aim at several state officials.

articles.title: Trump Backs CFTC Over Prediction Markets, Calls State Officials ‘Scum’
articles.snippet: Federal oversight gains the president’s backing as states push to bring prediction markets under their own gambling laws.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Trump Hints That Iran Deal May Be Close, Markets Rebound
articles.snippet: Markets bounced back on Trump's “largely negotiated” U.S.-Iran deal, but further airstrikes underscore the fragile geopolitical position.
